Done on branch fix/backlog-round-2: tools/lint_markdown.py (stdlib-only, palette_lint mould). Covers lazy continuations, unclosed fences and headings with no blank line above. The lazy-continuation rule is narrow BY DESIGN — indentation cannot separate the bug from a wrapped bullet line (both at column 0), so it fires only on block-shaped leads CommonMark cannot start mid-paragraph (**strong**, table row, link reference definition). Wrapped prose and HTML comments are exempt by rule, not by allowlist, so no ignore pragma exists. Documented cost: a PLAIN prose paragraph glued to a bullet is not caught, being indistinguishable from wrapped text. Verified: silent on all 13 tracked .md (and 16 under skills/), fires on the original **bold**-glued-to-bullet shape; 37 lint cases in tools/smoke_test_tools.py, SMOKE: ALL PASS.

Done on branch fix/backlog-round-2. FIRST FINDING: the tracker's numbers were computed in the wrong colour space — they weight raw sRGB-encoded Color components as if already linear (Color.get_luminance()'s maths) against raw bg_color with alpha ignored. Under the real WCAG piecewise transform, composited down each pair's real layer stack, candy is 5.09 not 2.78, noir 6.66 not 3.69, verdant 6.67 not 3.58, amber 7.10 not 4.00. The compositing crux is settled by measurement: secondary buttons are 0.95 over a 0.88 panel over a 0.86 backdrop, so gameplay leakage is 0.084% — below one 8-bit step — and where leakage IS real (HUD pill, 32%) evaluating over both black and white bounds it with no assumption. ONE FIGURE HELD UP: bloodmoon's primary button was genuinely broken (4.14 normal / 3.47 hover, and neither black nor white ink could reach 4.5 against that red). Chose a hybrid: (a) a composited contrast arm on palette_lint with --contrast-table, 16 pairs, bars 4.5 and 3.0; ui_theme.gd's ink pick is now measured (best_ink/min_contrast/contrast_ratio/relative_luminance/composite exported for user screens) instead of a get_luminance() > 0.4 guess; (b) two palette values changed — bloodmoon ACCENT to (0.76,0.14,0.13), fixing primary hover 3.47 -> 4.79, and clinical TEXT_FAINT to (0.41,0.47,0.51), 3.00 -> 3.46, which the new check found unprompted; (c) documented honestly that the crosshair ring and bare Glyph draws have NO surface behind them so no ratio exists — the kit answers those with geometry, and the by-hand check is your brightest scene. Engine assertions added to smoke_test.gd reading real StyleBoxFlat.bg_color, because the lint replicates style_button's derivation and that replica is what goes stale. Verified: silent on all six palettes and both template sets, fires on the pre-fix bloodmoon accent (4.03) and on a hand-written unreadable palette (12 pairs), five engine assertions shown red against the defects they describe; SMOKE/JUICE/PALETTE green under all six palettes; five shared files still byte-identical.
